title: Finalize and Commit Context Bootstrap
objective: Independently revalidate QM2-P0-001, commit its exact original scope, preserve its historical run, and record finalization in a separate immutable run and commit.
scope: Revalidate the original QM2-P0-001 context bootstrap and manifest scope.
Commit exactly the original 43-file P0-001 bundle.
Update only the human-readable and machine-readable Current State and Handoff documents.
Create a separate local finalization commit without pushing.
explicit_non_goals: No database, API, indexer, TDX, Dataset Snapshot, factor, model, Qlib, risk, UI, or runtime implementation.
No dependency installation, lockfile change, configuration change, amend, squash, rebase, or push.
No modification, copy, or formatting of the official Factor Lab source.

known_limitations: Manifest v1 lacks a first-class non-correction related_run_id; parent_task_id and the report carry the relationship.
Current State and Handoff v1 enums cannot encode QM2-P0-002A directly; machine context records parent QM2-P0-002.
Handoff v1 cannot encode completed_committed, so its legal generation-time completion_status remains completed_uncommitted while clean post-commit state is represented separately.
A commit cannot embed its own hash; result_commit identifies the P0-001 commit being finalized and Git history identifies the commit containing this run.
The Implementation Ledger is still file-based; PostgreSQL persistence, Project Knowledge API, and web query UI are unimplemented.
Four Markdown hard-break trailing spaces remain in the immutable P0-001 commit.
unresolved_questions: What first-class relationship model should the future Ledger use for finalizes, supersedes, corrects, and depends-on relations?
Should the next schema revision admit subtask identifiers and committed handoff status?
Which durable location will replace the official Factor Lab /tmp source?
rollback_information: Revert the finalization commit to remove this run and four derived context updates; revert 5504bdb94ddf817976f74a09e323cf8fb1eacf4a separately to remove P0-001. No business, database, data, model, Qlib, dependency, or runtime rollback is required.
security_impact: No secrets, external writes, runtime permissions, or network access were added; Factor Lab remained read-only.
data_lineage_impact: No data lineage artifact changed; this run records only implementation and Git lineage.
